build_graph_attention_block: build a GraphAttentionBlock module with global, molecular graph, GNN, and regularization configs for molecular graph neural networks
run_graph_attention_forward: run the GraphAttentionBlock forward pass with GraphAttentionData and neighbor representations tensor to get updated neighbor reps
create_feedforward_network: create a FeedForwardNetwork module with configurable hidden size, activation, normalization, and residual scaling for graph neural networks
test_feedforward_forward: test the FeedForwardNetwork forward pass with a tensor input to verify normalization and residual connection output
review_graph_attention_block_init: review the GraphAttentionBlock initialization to understand how neighborhood attention, edge FFN, node attention, and node FFN submodules are configured
